expectations.text: B1: Diagnoses and gives a minimal fix or hint
expectations.evidence: Diagnoses shadow acne: "浮点舍入让 P 实际上略微落在球面内侧...这条 shadow ray 会以 t ≈ 0 再次击中球体自己，于是球体'遮挡了自己'" and gives minimal fix: "Vec3 shadowOrig = hitPos + N * 1e-3f" plus "if (t > 1e-4f) return t;"

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: No concrete command to run is given; the ending is only "改完后黑点应完全消失，阴影边缘干净。如果还有残留噪声，把求交代码贴出来" — expected behaviour without a runnable command/checkpoint

expectations.text: B3: Explains self-intersection from floating-point error and fixes it with a small t_min/epsilon offset (e.g. 0.001)
expectations.evidence: Explains self-intersection from floating-point error: "浮点舍入让 P 实际上略微落在球面内侧（或正好在球面上）。这条 shadow ray 会以 t ≈ 0 再次击中球体自己" and fixes with epsilon offsets: "hitPos + N * 1e-3f", "对 shadow ray 传一个 t_min = 1e-4 的下界"

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); if tools are needed it asks the learner to install them
expectations.evidence: FILES WRITTEN IN PROJECT (0); SHELL COMMANDS RUN (1): only "ls -la"; no install commands and nothing written outside the workspace
